[Benzinga news, 2026-10-21T15:01:43Z, by staff] Elbit Systems Acquires ISE
Elbit Systems has expanded its technical capabilities through the acquisition of ISE.
Elbit Systems has announced the acquisition of ISE, a move intended to expand the company's technical competence and capabilities. This acquisition represents a strategic development for the company as it seeks to enhance its existing portfolio. The integration of ISE is expected to contribute to the company's broader operational and technological goals.
